notes: Reviewed the official Sasaki corner exterior photo and Purdue Krach stairwell photo; replaced broad center-glass and generic full-width stripe cues with a corner multi-level glass bay, transparent Main Street storefront, repeated pale-surround upper windows, and an explicit named entrance.
Rebuilt the front shell as segmented facade panels around openings instead of a Boolean-cut wall; GIS exterior ring and source envelope bounds remain unchanged.

Added a source-informed, schematic 4-story switchback stair with 88 treads, four intermediate landings, pale warm tread material and translucent etched-glass gallery guards. A guard-coordinate error found during review was corrected; stair bounds are now -0.97 to 15.64 m.

Replaced five flat schematic floor plates with shallow GIS-outline slabs and a stairwell void at all levels; inset perimeter edges 0.28 m to keep floor slabs behind the masonry facade and remove coplanar striping.
Adjusted facade glazing to show the stair through the saved exterior view and produced a separate stairwell cutaway preview.
Added a source-backed pale limestone roof-edge fascia and coping aligned to the unchanged GIS roof perimeter; flat roof remains the documented photo silhouette.

Added a low mechanical penthouse volume after the engineer source confirmed the feature; its 9.2 x 4.8 x 1.92 m size and roof position are explicitly schematic because no elevation/roof plan is available.

Rebuilt stair routing so each half-flight lands on a shared intermediate or full-floor connector, with 32 handrail splines tracing flight and landing edges. Added connection rationale and schematic limits to object metadata.

Sasakis corner photograph observations are attached to the curtainwall, punched-window, storefront and entrance object metadata; window cadence/width remains image-interpreted and is not presented as measured.
